useCases.title: Faster onboarding, a complete employee record from day one!
useCases.summary: From intake, skills passport and skills assessment to vocational education certificates in her own wallet. When she applies for a job, the employer can see within seconds which requirements have been demonstrably met.
useCases.userJourney:
Samira wants to work in childcare but is moving from another sector. She signs up with ECHT, where her skills, motivations and experience are mapped and used to build her skills passport. Diplomas, certificates and previous training are linked to it, while Samira remains in control.

A skills assessment then compares her profile with the requirements of the role. Any gaps become her development pathway rather than a reason for rejection. The education provider delivers the additional training and issues the resulting vocational education certificate as a verifiable credential directly to Samira’s wallet.

When applying for a job, Samira decides what to share. The employer can instantly verify her diplomas, certificates, training and validated skills. No separate PDFs, email exchanges or duplicate checks. ECHT recruits, assesses and supports; the education provider issues; the employer verifies; and Samira controls what she shares and with whom.
